about: Decisions for the Others page of the official Arts (/collection/arts/others). others.py reads this file. The owner's rule: the art folders, the chibi folders and the poster folders of media/_all go to Others, with what the Splash helper moved here, the old Arts pictures that are not splash art and the generated pictures of the art and poster folders (labelled). The pictures of a splash-art folder that are cut to a 16:9 window (official ones, and the generated ones labelled Made for this site) are in Splash art, not here. Every picture that is a candidate must be an item or be listed under dropped, or the script stops. A picture is found by the first 6 letters of its content hash (sha). A picture outside media/_all names its file in src. Change a title, an alt or a tag here and run the script again. A picture whose file or cut changes needs a new key: bump rev.
rules: Official art only. A picture made by an image generator is never labelled official: it is kind site, canon fan, tag made for this site, and the credit says Made for this site. A picture counts as generated when its file carries an OpenAI content credential (the caBX chunk of a PNG) or when the Splash helper marked it generated (4570f6 is a pixel exact crop of a generated file with the credential taken off). The script stops if a generated file is not kind site or a site picture is not generated. A generated picture of a splash-art folder is shown by Splash art, not here: only the ones of an art or poster folder stay (Vexana and Guinevere in a window, Vexana profile card).
Fan art, edits, cosplay and screenshots of the live-action parody are not shown here. Fan art belongs to the Fanart room.

One home per picture. A picture that another room already shows (Fanart, Design, Splash art, Scene, the Lore atlas) is not shown again. others.py stops if an item is also in curation/splash.json keep. A copy of a picture on a plain background or in a cut shape is a copy.

The picture is the whole picture. The only cut is a fully transparent border (crop transparent, alpha 8 or less), which holds no art. Small pictures are kept and shown at their own size, nothing is upscaled.
Where nothing says who made a picture or when, the field is absent. A credit is only given for a post that captions.json confirms and whose art the picture really is.

notes: e130af (Tetra, a chibi in angela/chibi) is the same picture as the Lore atlas card _others/character/tetra.png (distance 0, same size). It stays here as a chibi, as design.json expects. The main session may drop it if the Lore atlas should be its only home.
6e050c and 0e620a are cut outs of two film frames that the Scene room shows with a white background (layla/films/chibi 224902 and 224907). Here they show without the background.

On 11 Nov 2026 (second round) 17 pictures moved to Splash art: the 13 generated pictures of a splash-art folder (labelled Made for this site there) and four official ones that only the 1280 px rule had kept out (542b49, 50c9d9, 9fa979 and 76edb2, now that the page window needs 1000 px). Their mirror folders under arts/v2/others/ stay on disk, unused. 9fa979 (Guinevere raises a fist) has no known origin: it is in no post of captions.json, and it is labelled official by its look, so confirm it with the owner. d37e07 is the group art of 76edb2 in another frame, on a purple card with a pen, and is 720 px wide, so it stays here.
f9ec60 and 1aae89 are frames of an official animated film. They are in the Scene room (curation/scene-4.json).

Near copies were found with a 256 bit difference hash of every picture of the library composited on white (a plain one reads transparent pixels as black and misses a sticker and its screenshot). The pairs found are listed in dropped. The check against Fanart, Design and the Lore atlas found only the cases named in notes above and in dropped.
